definition: D03 treatment contract. Non-resume operations retain the default-safe statement budgets. Resume is excluded here because its blocking contract is a paired, sample-by-sample exact +1 query delta against a same-build resume_deltas=false control artifact.

baseline.method: Pair the treatment with a passing definitive 640K resume_deltas=false control through --resume-control-from. The D03 gate requires at least 30 paired samples, exactly +1 completed SQL statement per treatment resume, and treatment resume p95 no greater than 150ms.

open.variability: Lexical anchor/fallback shape and semantic-ready coverage.

search.variability: Lexical anchor/fallback shape and semantic-ready coverage.

write.fixture: One new, single-chunk Markdown entry with semantic work queued.

checkpoint.variability: The baseline checkpoint has no explicit source_refs; the bounded 64-source probe is reported separately.
